text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally the day of the Satsuki Sho, part of the Classic Triple Crown tour. Everyone is on the edge of their seat in anticipation of the explosive race that's about to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, in the runners' tunnel, Mihono Bourbon is psyching herself up for the race. Rice Shower tells her about how she looks up to her, as well as how she wants to catch up to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser chooses to simply watch them from afar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stands awkwardly off to the side, waiting for them to finish their conversation. In any case, the Satsuki Sho is about to begin!
